svg.title: Hub-spoke network reference
svg.desc: A DMZ virtual network connects through a secured virtual hub to a workload spoke. The hub contains Azure Firewall, Virtual WAN Hub, and a Virtual Network Gateway connected to an ExpressRoute circuit. The workload spoke contains external and internal Application Gateway subnets, workload and data subnets, and a private endpoint subnet. Routing intent states that Internet traffic is inspected and private traffic passes through the hub firewall.
svg.text: Internet, private, and hybrid access through a secured Azure hub and workload spoke.
